name: David Kohls

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single-story primary residence with a complex dark gray shingle roof and multiple skylights|An attached garage is present on one side of the house|A wide concrete driveway and front apron extend from the street to the garage|One vehicle is parked in the driveway|Landscaped areas with shrubs, flowers, and lawn surround the front and sides of the house|A patio or hardscape area is visible on one side|White fencing encloses portions of the side and rear yard|Trash bins are positioned near the street.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence shows a blue-gray single-story house with a dark gray roof and attached garage|A wide concrete driveway leads from the street to the garage|One vehicle is parked in the driveway|Landscaped front yard includes shrubs, flowers, and lawn|White fencing separates the front and back part of the property|Trash bins are located at the curb.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows the side of the house with the dark gray roof|Landscaping and trees extend along this side|The concrete driveway and front apron are visible toward the front of the property|Vegetation frames portions of the side yard.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows the back of the house with a patio or hardscape area|Landscaping, trees, and outdoor items are present in the rear yard|White fencing encloses the rear of the property|The side of the attached garage, a shed and a vehicle are visible toward the front.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side of the house, attached garage, and concrete driveway|One vehicle is parked near the garage|Landscaping and a white shed and fence section are present|The street frontage and trash bins are visible along the edge of the property.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a wide concrete driveway that leads directly from the street to the attached garage and front parking area. The driveway and front apron offer clear space for vehicle approach and staging. One vehicle is parked in the driveway. White fencing encloses portions of the side and rear yard. Landscaped areas with shrubs and trees surround the house. The property sits on a cul-de-sac loop with neighboring residences on multiple sides. Open lawn and hardscape areas are present around the structure.
clarifications: Does the attached garage provide direct interior access into the house? Is the white fencing fully continuous around the rear yard, or are there gates that allow side or rear access? Can emergency vehicles fully utilize the wide front driveway and apron without obstruction from the parked vehicle? Is there a secondary pedestrian or vehicle access point from the side or rear of the property? What is the nature of the patio or hardscape area on the side of the house?
